issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares the fields numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double, but the reference solution implements both fields as int. This mismatch can mislead students about the required field/constructor/getter/setter types and about whether fractional student counts are expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Prefer updating the UML (problem_statement.md) to use int for numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents (since they are counts). Alternatively, if doubles are intended, change the solution (and expected API) to double for these fields and update the constructor, getters/setters, and derived calculations accordingly.
